# SAE components whose images are pre-downloaded onto the device.
# The image list is generated by rendering the SAE helm chart (version MSU_SAE_VERSION)
# with these components enabled, see
# https://github.com/starwit/starwit-awareness-engine/tree/main/helm#image-provisioning
# Images of dependencies the chart always deploys (e.g. Valkey, monitoring) are included as well.
#
# All components are disabled by default to keep test installations short. A typical
# deployment enables positionSource, videoSource, objectDetector, objectTracker,
# frameAnonymizer, geoMapper, detectionAggregator, detectionSampler,
# cleaningStatusFilter and redisWriter.
#
# component            enabled
positionSource         false
videoSource            false
axisAdapter            false
cronistSource          false
objectDetector         false
objectTracker          false
frameAnonymizer        false
geoMapper              false
detectionAggregator    false
detectionSampler       false
cleaningStatusFilter   false
redisWriter            false
databaseWriter         false
api                    false
